title: Boss's Orders 181/190 sv4a Holo Pokemon Card Shiny Treasure ex Japanese TCG
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Boss's Orders 181/190 sv4a Holo Pokemon Card is a must-have for any serious collector or fan of the Pokemon Trading Card Game. With its stunning full art design and rare holo finish, this card is sure to impress and add a touch of excitement to any collection.

Featuring the powerful Boss's Orders character, this Trainer stage Pokemon is a valuable addition to any deck. The card is made from high-quality card stock and is manufactured by Pokemon in Japan. Don't miss your chance to own this amazing card from the Shiny Treasure ex set.
